subject.title: feat(memory-wiki): add wiki_open_items tool to list unresolved questions and contradictions

question: Should memory-wiki permanently expose `wiki_open_items` as a dedicated agent tool instead of enriching `wiki_lint` or another existing query surface?
rationale: The PR proves that structured enumeration is useful and implementable, but adding a sixth model-facing bundled-plugin tool is a durable product and API ownership choice.

options.title: Add Dedicated Tool
options.body: Accept `wiki_open_items` as the focused read-only enumeration contract after removing the test-only export exemptions.

options.title: Extend Wiki Lint
options.body: Return structured open items, filters, and contradiction variants through the existing `wiki_lint` surface to keep the public tool set smaller.

options.title: Defer To Parent Design
options.body: Wait until the broader interactive resolution workflow defines the exact enumeration and write-back contract it requires.

recommendation.title: Add Dedicated Tool
recommendation.body: Accept `wiki_open_items` as the focused read-only enumeration contract after removing the test-only export exemptions.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly evolved the exact memory-wiki tool, lint, dashboard, and claim-health surfaces involved in this API choice.
